# AxoraBD

> AxoraBD (Axora BD) is Bangladesh's trusted micro-task & earning platform. Users complete simple online tasks, submit proofs, earn rewards and withdraw via bKash, Nagad or Rocket.

AxoraBD lets publishers post paid micro-tasks (likes, follows, comments, subscribes, views, app installs, etc.) and lets earners complete those tasks for cash rewards. Payouts go to local mobile-money wallets in Bangladesh.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of AxoraBD, features, stats, how it works.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, contact and social links.
- [Sign Up](/auth/register): Create a free AxoraBD account.
- [Login](/auth/login): Sign in to an existing account.
